annotations.title: Who provides each capital stack layer

description: Names of firms in the business of each layer, only as the institutions publish them: Fannie Mae DUS lenders and Freddie Mac Optigo lenders (senior agency multifamily debt) and public mortgage REITs that hold mezzanine loans or preferred equity per their 10-Qs. Filter by list or by part of a name. Being on a list does not mean a firm will quote a given deal.

name.description: Optional part of a firm name to look for, e.g. "Walker" or "Arbor".
